name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Experimental iOS classic-cube predictive tap delay for supported static geometry. Practice testing only; orb/pad and dynamic cases bypass prediction.

buffer-stage.name: Input Buffer Stage
buffer-stage.description: 1 = 2, 2 = 4, 3 = 8, 4 = 16 native player-update calls; 5 = Off. Safe Mode ON restricts interventions to Practice/editor; unsupported cases pass through.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Enables experimental classic-cube prediction for supported static geometry. Other modes and orb/pad, slope, grouped, rotated, or dynamic interactions are passed through.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: ON: new input interventions are restricted to Practice/editor. This is not complete save protection. OFF allows prediction interventions during normal play; do not use for progress attempts.

show-debug-overlay.name: Show Debug Overlay
show-debug-overlay.description: Show per-player prediction status, unsupported reason, snapshot objects, candidates, selected delay, and actual input overrides.
